rationale: Plan addresses all objective elements: claim status splits via claim_volume with status breakdown and figure; denial rate and fraud prevalence at portfolio level; financial distributions via financial_summary with all three amount columns and quantiles; monthly trends via monthly_trend tracking claim count and paid spend. Three evolved skills apply: synthetic_data caveat (evolved_run_012_001) documents the synthetic nature of the analysis; descriptive_only caveat (evolved_run_012_002) clarifies that distributions and trends are descriptive without causal claims; cite_artifacts (evolved_run_012_006) applies citation discipline for executive-facing communication to the head of claims. Denominators are explicitly displayed to emphasize statistical discipline and rate clarity.
